_comment: TransformerPath Global Projects — structured transformer-relevant grid, substation and transmission projects worldwide (World → Region → Country → Utility → Project → Transformer Scope → Manufacturer/Award). A project is a distinct build/tender/award, NOT an article. Fields are only included where sourced; 'transformer_requirement' grades whether transformer scope is explicitly documented (CONFIRMED), reasonably inferred from substation/grid scope (INFERRED), or not yet known (UNKNOWN). 'region' groups by world region (Middle East, Asia, Europe, North America, Latin America, Africa, Oceania). 'last_verified' records when the source was checked. Values marked null / omitted are not invented; a transformer manufacturer/award is recorded only when explicitly sourced. Maintained from public tender/project databases, utility/regulator announcements and reputable industry reporting.
